input.prompt: Animate the first frame exactly: same framing, composition, lighting, setting and character. A solo wushu changquan performer shows the second international compulsory long-fist routine, crisp, fast and powerful, then sharp stops. She stands on one straight leg with the other knee raised high and both fists chambered, and holds the balance perfectly still. About 1.7 seconds in, still balanced on one leg, she throws one sharp horizontal punch out to the side (tixi heng quan). About 2.6 seconds in she puts the raised foot down and takes two quick hop-steps IN PLACE (jibu), not running, staying the same size in the frame. About 3.5 seconds in she springs off her left foot into a flying front kick (tengkong feijiao): a real jump of about half a second, her right foot snaps straight up to head height and her right hand slaps the instep at the top of the jump, about 3.9 seconds in, her left knee tucked, her high ponytail visible. About 4.3 seconds in she lands on both feet, knees bent, and holds still to the end. Each named move lands exactly on a beat of the reference audio. One performer only, the same woman from start to end: two arms, two legs, one head; no limb appears, vanishes, doubles or detaches; nobody else ever appears. Real weight and momentum: knees bend on every landing, the planted foot never slides, sneakers stay on the water between steps. She stays inside the centre of the frame, travelling at most a step or two. The camera is LOCKED OFF on a tripod: no pan, no zoom, no push, no reframing, the horizon stays level. Her mouth stays closed. Same face and eyes as the first frame; she keeps her high ponytail, her orange bands and the round white '1420 MHz' patch on her LEFT upper arm. One continuous shot at real speed, no slow motion, no cuts. No captions, no text.
